ad_library.summary: Valcan Solar is running 2 active ads on Meta for the MEGA UTSAV bumper-draw campaign - one since 7 October 2026 pointing at valcansolar.com, one since 15 October 2026 pointing at a Facebook lead form. The offer (free solar system as first prize, EV bikes, Rs. 78,000 subsidy plus Rs. 22,000 discount, 0% EMI) runs until 24 November with the draw on 30 November. Both ads surfaced in the 'solar Secunderabad' search - their home market.

funnel.type: Split - own site + Facebook lead form
funnel.destination: valcansolar.com ('Book now') on one ad, a Facebook lead form ('Call Us') on the other
funnel.meaning: Half the spend lands on a page you own; half lands inside Facebook. Two destinations for one offer means two different experiences for the same click, and the Facebook side leaves you no pixel, no retargeting pool and nothing to test.

findings: 2 live ads running the MEGA UTSAV bumper-draw offer (free solar system as first prize, EV bikes, air fryers) until 24 November, draw 30 November - a deadline-driven push with real money behind it.
One ad sends clicks to valcansolar.com, the other into a Facebook lead form. The same offer, two different funnels - and the Facebook side owns none of the data.

The site's 'Our Achievements' counters all read 0 - 0K+ projects completed, 0% positive feedback, 0+ years of experience, 0% success rate. A visitor who just clicked a bumper-draw ad sees a brand-new company.
The contact block's email reads marketing@vulcansolar.in - misspelled ('vulcansolar'), while the header shows info@valcansolar.com instead. Enquiries may not reach either inbox.
The contact block's phone link shows +91 9010008373 while the displayed number is +91 90300 33577 - two different numbers in the same block.
The site itself claims 'since 2012', ISO 9001:2008 certification and 15+ years of experience - the substance is there, it just never reaches the paid visitor.
next_steps: Unify the two ads on one owned page
Point both MEGA UTSAV ads at one landing page on valcansolar.com with the offer, the prize list and the 24 November deadline on it - so the spend builds one measurable funnel.
0+ years of experience and 0K+ projects read as a startup. Real numbers on a deadline-driven campaign page are the difference between a click and a call.
Correct marketing@vulcansolar.in to a working valcansolar.com address and make the phone link match the displayed number - on a draw with a hard deadline, a broken enquiry path is a lost prize entry.
Build the deadline into the page
Offer valid to 24 Nov, draw on 30 Nov - a countdown and a 'book before the draw' CTA turn urgency into conversions.

controls.name: Meta Pixel installed
controls.evidence: Landing page was not source-checked for this report; needs a page-source pull or account access.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Live ads click to a Facebook lead form (fb.me) - traffic never reaches a page you own, so no URL can carry UTMs and click data stays inside Meta.

controls.name: Domain verification
controls.evidence: Business Manager domain verification cannot be observed from public ad data; needs account access.

controls.name: Creative format diversity
controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative concept coverage
controls.evidence: 5 distinct offer angles in live copy: government subsidy, subsidy amount, discount offer, EMI / financing, bill savings.

controls.name: Social proof utilization
controls.evidence: No social proof (customer counts, reviews, testimonials) in the live ad copy.

controls.name: Video aspect ratios
controls.evidence: Creative files cannot be downloaded from the Ad Library; needs account access or the raw creatives.

controls.name: UGC / social-native content
controls.evidence: Content style cannot be verified from ad cards alone.

controls.name: CTR benchmark
controls.evidence: No spend or impression data is public for this advertiser; the catalog forbids benchmark guessing.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started Oct 7, 2026) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: 2 distinct live ads visible - a comparison is at least possible.

controls.name: Campaign objective alignment
controls.evidence: Ad CTA and destination agree on one job: Split - own site + Facebook lead form.

controls.name: Creative fatigue detection
controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
